title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
snippet: The RAG paper describes combining a parametric generator with a non-parametric memory retrieved from an external corpus. Retrieval supplies task-relevant evidence without requiring all knowledge to be stored in model parameters.

title: Production RAG: Retrieval Quality Is Part of Answer Quality
snippet: Production RAG systems introduce retrieval, ranking, indexing, latency, and monitoring concerns. Stale or irrelevant context can degrade an answer even when the language model is capable.

title: A Practical Survey of Retrieval-Augmented Generation
snippet: Survey literature positions RAG between static model knowledge and external evidence. It can improve freshness and domain adaptation, but adds a dependency on corpus coverage and retriever behavior.

title: Evaluating Grounded Generation with Retrieval
snippet: Evaluation for retrieval-grounded generation should inspect both retrieval quality and answer faithfulness. End-to-end accuracy alone can hide failures caused by missing or misleading context.
